Check governing headings, definitions, exceptions and current source.","text":"The 8 week rule


077002 The temporary absence can be up to 8 weeks where


1. the absence is not expected to exceed 8 weeks and


2. the absence is in connection with the death of


      2.1 the claimant’s partner or


      2.2 a child or qualifying young person who normally lives with the claimant or


      2.3 a close relative of the claimant, their partner or a child or qualifying young person normally
      living with the claimant and


the Secretary of State considers that it would be unreasonable to expect the claimant to return to GB
